# agent.yaml reference

Every key of an agent's manifest, generated from `ragkit.agents.manifest`. Paths such as `system_prompt` and `output_schema` are relative to the agent's folder. Unknown keys are rejected.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | Unique name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. |
| `description` | string | `""` | Shown in listings and to supervisors choosing whom to delegate to. |
| `pattern` | `react` \| `rag-chat` \| `plan-execute` \| `supervisor` \| `swarm` \| `pipeline` | `"react"` | `react` (tool loop), `rag-chat` (retrieve once, then answer) or `supervisor` (delegates to `subagents`); other values run as `react`. |
| `model` | string \| null | — | Defaults to the project's model. |
| `fallback_models` | list of string | `[]` | Models tried in order when the main model fails. |
| `system_prompt` | string | `"prompts/system.md"` | Path relative to the agent's folder. |
| `retrieval` | [object](#retrieval) \| null | — | Search the project's collections. |
| `subagents` | list of string | `[]` | Other agents in the project this agent can delegate to. |
| `output_schema` | string \| null | — | 'file.py:Model' in the agent's folder; the agent returns that structure. |
| `tools` | [object](#tools) | see below | Functions and MCP tools the agent can call. |
| `memory` | [object](#memory) | see below | Conversation memory. |
| `guardrails` | list of any | `[]` | pii, prompt_injection or deny guardrails; see ragkit.agents.guardrails. |
| `hitl` | [object](#hitl) | see below | Human approval of tool calls. |
| `budget` | [object](#budget) | see below | Limits for each request. |
| `evals` | [object](#evals) | see below | Dataset and gates for `ragkit eval agent`. |

## `retrieval`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collections` | list of string | **required** | Collections to search, as named in ragkit.yaml. |
| `mode` | `dense` \| `sparse` \| `hybrid` | `"hybrid"` | `dense` (embeddings), `sparse` (BM25 keywords) or `hybrid` (both, fused). |
| `top_k` | integer | `6` | Passages given to the model per search. |
| `candidates` | integer | `50` | Results fetched before reranking. |
| `rerank` | [object](#retrievalrerank) \| null | — | Overrides the project's reranker for this agent. |
| `use_rerank` | boolean | `true` | Set to false to skip reranking for this agent. |

## `retrieval.rerank`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | **required** | Reranker plugin: cohere, voyage or cross-encoder. |
| `model` | string \| null | — | Model name; each provider has a default. |
| `top_n` | integer | `8` | Results kept after reranking when a search does not ask for a number. |

## `tools`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `local` | list of string | `[]` | Names of functions or tools defined in tools.py. |
| `mcp` | list of [object](#toolsmcp) | `[]` | Tools from MCP servers. |

## `tools.mcp[]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server` | string | **required** | Name of a server under `mcp_servers` in ragkit.yaml. |
| `allow` | list of string | `[]` | Tool allowlist; empty allows all. |

## `memory`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checkpointer` | `memory` \| `postgres` | `"memory"` | `memory` (per process, lost on restart) or `postgres` (shared by every replica). |
| `long_term` | boolean | `false` | Not acted on yet. |

## `hitl`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `require_approval` | list of string | `[]` | Tools that pause for a human decision before running. |
| `decisions` | list of `approve` \| `edit` \| `reject` | `["approve", "edit", "reject"]` | What a reviewer may do with a pending call. |

## `budget`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_steps` | integer | `12` | Model calls allowed per request. |
| `max_cost_usd` | number \| null | — | End the run politely once it has cost this much; needs a price under `pricing`. |

## `evals`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | string \| null | — | JSONL eval cases, relative to the agent folder. |
| `gate` | map of string to number | `{}` | Minimum per metric, or a maximum with a `max_` prefix; `ragkit eval` exits 1 when one fails.      |

## Guardrails

Entries of `guardrails`. `pii` and `prompt_injection` may also be written as plain strings to use their defaults.

### `type: pii`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `pii` | **required** | Guardrail kind. |
| `kinds` | list of string | `["email", "credit_card", "ip", "phone", "iban"]` | What to detect: email, credit_card, ip, mac_address, url, phone, iban, or names defined in `patterns`. |
| `patterns` | map of string to string | `{}` | Extra kinds as name: regex. |
| `strategy` | `redact` \| `mask` \| `hash` | `"redact"` | `redact` ([REDACTED_EMAIL]), `mask` (jo.doe@****.com) or `hash` (<email_hash:…>). |
| `apply_to` | list of `input` \| `output` \| `tool_results` | `["input", "output"]` | Where to look: user messages, model replies, tool results. |

### `type: prompt_injection`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `prompt_injection` | **required** | Guardrail kind. |
| `action` | `annotate` \| `drop` | `"annotate"` | `annotate` marks flagged content as untrusted data; `drop` removes it. |
| `patterns` | list of string | `[]` | Extra regexes to flag. |

### `type: deny`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `deny` | **required** | Guardrail kind. |
| `patterns` | list of string | **required** | Case-insensitive regexes. |
| `message` | string | `"Sorry, I can't help with that request."` | Reply sent instead of calling the model. |
